headline: Stockpiling to Support Oil Prices in 2027 Amid Depleted Inventories
summary: Depleted inventories are set to drive a major stockpiling push next year, supporting oil prices despite an expected market surplus, with China leading global stockpiling.
why: Global inventory levels and strategic stockpiling by major economies like China influence international crude price trends.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Anticipated inventory stockpiling is expected to provide support to oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
